$comment: The identity area's alerts (spec 02 §18.2; spec 08 §7.8 group C). auth-endpoint-unlisted, from the steward's ruling of 22 Nov: the API halves write auth.endpoint_blocked (console's developer realm, admin's staff realm, verify with none); the query counts every line whose class is not blocked, so a line that lost its class counts as unlisted and the alert fails closed. secret-unreadable: any auth.secret_unreadable (identity's authenticator code check on console and admin, console's viewer for backup codes). rate-limiter-failing: any limits.store_failed (identity's limiter, which the realms and the organisation routes use on console and admin; spec 05's edge and api join with the keys lane). csrf-refused-jump: csrf.refused above the pre-deploy baseline, the overlay's threshold, in 15 minutes (web-host's origin gate on console, admin and verify, and identity's cross-site GET check on console and admin). Each has one incident per service, the label held to the rule's sources: any other value, a missing one included, is the one label `other`. L-SAT-09 owes the rest of the area's alerts (catalog/owed.ts).

alerts.name: auth-endpoint-unlisted
alerts.incident_cause: Requests for /api/auth/* paths the realm does not list, above their threshold in 15 minutes: a client or library change calling an unlisted path, or probing. Count: {{value}}.

metadata.check: The realm and release on the lines; the request lines with the same requestId and their cfRay; whether the count began with a release.

alerts.name: secret-unreadable
alerts.incident_cause: A stored secret (an authenticator's secret, or backup codes) that no configured BETTER_AUTH_SECRETS version opens: the people it belongs to cannot finish a sign-in or step-up with their authenticator. Lines: {{value}}.

metadata.check: The kind and realm on auth.secret_unreadable and the release; the BETTER_AUTH_SECRETS versions on the service against the last rotation (a version removed while secrets it wrote remain).

alerts.name: rate-limiter-failing
alerts.incident_cause: The limiter could not read or write its counts in Postgres, so it failed closed and refused requests with 503: sign-ins and every limited step are refused while it lasts. Failures: {{value}}.

metadata.check: Postgres for the service: database-unreachable, pool-exhausted and the probe's longest transaction; the bucket on limits.store_failed; a run holding a lock on ops.rate_window or ops.lockout; grants-drift for the service's role.

alerts.name: csrf-refused-jump
alerts.incident_cause: Origin-gate refusals above the pre-deploy baseline in 15 minutes: the app's host and the origin or app name the service expects have drifted apart, usually with a deploy. Refusals: {{value}}.

metadata.check: The reason and route on csrf.refused and the release; FIN_PUBLIC_ORIGIN on the service against the app's host, and the X-Fin-App name the app's client sends.
